subject: Follow-up: brief product showcase — pick two windows
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@cirrushealth.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: brief product showcase — pick two windows

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful context on pain around inference costs and the latency spikes you see for patient-facing features. Quick recap so we’re aligned:

- Primary goal: reduce 95th-percentile latency for document summarization workflows while keeping per-token cost ~flat.
- Key stakeholders you flagged: Data platform (ops), Security/compliance, and a product owner who owns the summarization feature.

Next step from our side: a 30-minute product showcase where we run through a short demo, share a lightweight ops checklist, and map out a mutual action plan. Can you please pick one of these windows (all PT):

1) Tue Jul 22 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed Jul 23 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Thu Jul 24 — 08:30–09:00 PT (early slot)

If none of those work, feel free to propose two alternatives and we’ll do our best to adapt. Suggested attendees to invite from your side: the engineering lead who owns inference (or a proxy) and whoever manages security or compliance for external-facing features. From our side I’ll bring Priyom (solutions engineer) and potentially Marissa (customer success) depending on the focus.

I attached a 30-minute agenda and a short one-pager on what we’ll cover so stakeholders can scan ahead.

Attachments: product-one-pager.pdf (1 page), 30min-demo-agenda.md (agenda)

Agenda highlights: 5min context, 12min live demo (latency/cost controls), 8min ops/readout, 5min next steps.

Thanks — I’ll hold the three windows while I hear back.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

---

From: Elena Torres <elena@cirrushealth.io>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: brief product showcase — pick two windows

Thanks Lukas — good summary.

Cirrus will be interested in the latency controls piece. Quick heads-up on attendees: I’ll bring our inference owner (Ben O'Neill, ben.oneill@cirrushealth.io) and our security lead (Maya Singh, maya.singh@cirrushealth.io). Ben can only do late-afternoon slots on most days.

Of the options you proposed, the best matches for the two stakeholders above are:

- Wed Jul 23 — 14:00–14:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu Jul 24 — 08:30–09:00 PT (backup, although Ben may be late)

If you can lock Wed 23 @ 14:00 PT, we’ll accept and Ben and Maya will join. Otherwise propose an alternative after 16:00 PT on Tue or Wed next week.

Thanks,
Elena
Sr. Product Manager — Clinical Workflows
Cirrus Health

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@cirrushealth.io>, Ben O'Neill <ben.oneill@cirrushealth.io>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@cirrushealth.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: brief product showcase — pick two windows

Perfect — thanks for the quick turn. Wed Jul 23 @ 14:00–14:30 PT is locked on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite to everyone now (calendar-invite.ics attached).

A few quick notes so the meeting is as useful as possible:

- Goal: show a focused flow that demonstrates how our runtime reduces tail latency and how routing/pinning works for mixed-criticality workloads.
- Priyom will demo with a small dataset representative of your summarization workload.
- Success criteria for this session: confirm rough latency delta for your baseline vs. our run, and identify the right follow-up owners for an evaluation pilot.

Prep items for your team:
- Ben: if possible, send a 1-paragraph summary of current infra (GPU/CPU mix, inference host patterns) before EOD Tue so Priyom can tailor the demo.
- Maya: if you have any quick security constraints to check (data residency, KMS approach), flag them so we can surface relevant docs in the meeting.

If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (invite)
